# Onnesha Hospital Management System (OHMS) - System & Infrastructure Profile

> This document defines the official technical architecture, infrastructure specifications, and hosting tier for Onnesha Hospital & Diagnostic Complex.

## 1. Domain & Digital Identity
- Primary Production Domain: https://onneshahospital.com
- Domain Classification: Commercial Top-Level Domain (TLD) with ICANN Privacy Shield
- Domain Valuation / Registration Cost: $10 - $50 USD / year
- Nameservers & DNS: Global Anycast Cloud DNS Protection

## 2. Infrastructure & Cloud Hosting Architecture
- Platform Tier: Dedicated Enterprise Healthcare Cloud Cluster
- Cloud Infrastructure Valuation / Hosting Fee: $25 - $65 USD / month (Dedicated Compute Tier with High Availability & Failover)
- Database Architecture: Dedicated Enterprise PostgreSQL High-Availability Relational Database Cluster (Private VPC, multi-region replication, automated daily snapshots)
- Storage & CDN: Enterprise Edge Content Distribution Network with Encrypted Object Storage
- Security & Compliance: Strict Row-Level Security (RLS), Encrypted TLS 1.3 at rest and in transit, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
- Operational SLA: 99.9% High Availability Production Uptime

## 3. Application Profile
- Application Type: Enterprise Hospital Information System (HIS / EMR), 24/7 Outpatient & Inpatient Clinical Suite
- Client Subsystems: Cross-Platform Progressive Web App (PWA) & Tauri 2 Native Desktop Client
- Status: Commercial Production Live
